name: Full Brightness Toggle
summary: Client-side mod that toggles the game's brightness (gamma) to maximum with a single key, giving a night-vision-like fullbright view in caves and at night. Press the key again to return to your normal setting.
qol: Instant gamma toggle, originally requested for players with impaired eyesight
commands_and_keybinds: G: toggle full brightness (rebindable in Options > Controls)
editor_notes: Server rules may forbid fullbright; the author advises asking first on public servers.
